bodyParagraphs.text: A stronger working-capital case starts with a clearer production story.

The Kanan Supplier Programme helps Indian manufacturers organise the evidence behind their orders, materials and production plans, review external risks, and prepare for questions from their chosen bank or NBFC.
Selected suppliers receive hands-on support at no charge. You control the application; the lender makes the decision.
